root_idea.summary: The root centers on making or bringing something into a formed state, especially through effective or skilled workmanship.
root_idea.development: From making with skill, the lexical field extends to craft, careful tending and cultivation, constructed works, and specialized derived uses such as reciprocal inducement and bribery. Some nominal branches designate manufactured objects, occupations, or built installations.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Normalized Form VIII perfect citation form.
Displayed as the lexical noun صَنْعَةٌ rather than the inflected Quranic accusative.
Displayed as the lexical noun صُنْعٌ rather than its inflected Quranic forms.
Displayed under the supported singular citation form مَصْنَعَةٌ; the Quran occurrence is its plural مَصَانِعُ.

senses.definition: To make, fashion, construct, or perform something through deliberate and effective workmanship.
senses.usage_conditions: Used both for producing or constructing things and for carrying out deeds or acts; the passive construction in 20:39 has a specialized sense of being reared or cultivated, listed separately.

senses.definition: To rear, nourish, educate, or cultivate someone with sustained care and attention.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially supported in the construction وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَى عَيْنِي, where the passive verb expresses being brought up under close supervision; the evidence does not restrict the construction to a particular gender or age.

senses.definition: To specially choose or select someone for a designated purpose or office.
senses.usage_conditions: In وَاصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي, the choice is presented as a special divine selection for a required mission.

senses.definition: To cultivate, rear, or prepare someone with exceptional care for a designated purpose.
senses.usage_conditions: The same Quranic construction is also interpreted as special rearing and preparation; this is more than ordinary making or selection.

senses.definition: Craft, handiwork, workmanship, or the making of a manufactured object.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran occurrence refers to the making or workmanship of protective armor; the lexical meaning is the craft or manufacture, not armor as a general semantic restriction.

senses.definition: Skilled making, workmanship, or a work produced through effective and well-executed action.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the noun for works or efforts and for God's perfectly executed making; it denotes a skilled act or its result rather than every undifferentiated فعل.

senses.definition: A substantial constructed establishment or built structure, especially a stronghold or imposing work.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran occurrence is plural مَصَانِعَ and is associated with notable constructed places; broader Classical uses of the plural include reservoirs, wells, towns, and other installations, which are recorded separately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fabricate or forge speech, a saying, sentence, or poetry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of making, used with speech or poetic composition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To work at, practise, or exercise an art, craft, or manufacture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object of the working may be left understood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To do someone a favor or benefit, or to do someone an evil or foul deed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in constructions with إِلَى or بِهِ; the meaning is a deed performed toward another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tend a horse well, supplying and fattening it; also to rear or educate a person well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized care-and-nurture use, distinct from ordinary construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become skilled in an activity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported by one authority, while another authority states that this verb has not been heard.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Doing something for someone in expectation that the recipient will do something in return.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The basic Form III reciprocal or transactional construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Treating someone with gentleness, blandishment, coaxing, or conciliatory behavior; sometimes acting hypocritically or trying to turn someone aside by guile.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative interpersonal use of the reciprocal arrangement sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bribery or the act of bribing someone with property or money.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional figurative use, especially with a ruler, prefect, judge, or other official.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse's withholding or reserving part of its strength while moving.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equestrian use describing incomplete exertion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To aid or assist another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence also reports an erroneous interpretation of the expression as meaning that an unskilful person learned or became skilled; the supported lexical explanation is assistance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affecting a good or respectable manner of conduct and making a show of it, especially when the underlying claim to respect is unsound; also artificial self-adornment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form may describe conduct generally or personal embellishment; an illustrative feminine usage does not restrict the meaning by gender.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have an object made by commissioning or ordering its manufacture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested with a signet ring as the object commissioned.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To offer or present something, especially sustenance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported specialized use with an understood object in the cited expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prepare a repast, feast, or banquet for invited people, including food prepared for charitable distribution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of preparing something carefully; the charitable use is reported from tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask or cause another person to make something for oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form X construction expresses requesting or inducing manufacture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small creeping creature or insect, or a flying creature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate, rare lexical branch reported in the lexicographical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sustenance or provision.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal meaning distinct from the ordinary infinitive of صَنَعَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tailor or a delicate-handed, skilful worker.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A person-word describing manual dexterity, not the general noun for making.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wooden board, barrier, or assembled set of planks used to confine and retain water; also a rainwater trough or tank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural may designate wooden water barriers or unlined rainwater reservoirs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A manufactured or made object of any kind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete product or article is intended, such as a prepared container or similar manufactured item.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A turban.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized garment term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The iron spit or roasting instrument used for flesh-meat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized culinary implement meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Roasted flesh-meat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare nominal use, synonymous with the cited term for roasted meat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Skilled in work of the hands; a person adept at manual making.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to men or women; the source also records inflected and plural expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Skilled in the use of the tongue, especially eloquent; of a woman, sharp- or long-tongued.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from manual skill to verbal skill.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A habitual work, craft, trade, or occupation, especially handwork.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning may denote either the worker's craft or the work habitually practised.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Arrows that are uniform or evenly made, as the work of one maker.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized phrase; the lexical analysis of the form as a quasi-plural is reported tentatively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The seams, stitch-holes, or sewing thongs of a leather water-skin; alternatively, its making.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source reports several interpretations and no secure singular for the plural form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Made, wrought, manufactured, fabricated, or constructed; made skilfully or well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or nominal passive-result sense, distinct from the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Prepared food or a repast, feast, or banquet to which people are invited.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used for food prepared for distribution in the cause of God.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Applied to a sword or arrow: polished, tested by experience, and repeatedly renewed by polishing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of weapons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Well tended, especially of a horse supplied with fodder and fattened; of a person, reared, educated, disciplined, or trained well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The human and equine uses are reported as extensions of careful making or tending.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A goodly and clean garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal or adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A deed or action; especially a good deed, benefit, favor, or kind act.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same lexical family can also describe an evil or foul deed; the good-deed sense is conventional in صَنِيعَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People who tend their camels well, fatten their young animals, and withhold the camels' milk from guests.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized collective designation attested in poetry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An expert maker or manufacturer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also recorded as a proper name or surname.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A handicraftsman, artisan, manufacturer, or worker who makes things by hand; one who practises a craft.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May specifically mean a worker for hire under a master; its plural is صُنَّاعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most skilled in working with the hands, manufacturing, fabricating, or constructing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place, time, or way of making or doing; by extension, a place exhibiting good or skilful workmanship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form can function as an infinitive or as a noun of place or time; the cited poetic use concerns finding the proper way or site of an act.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A constructed reservoir, cistern, basin, or rainwater tank, including a well-like installation made for collecting water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural مَصَانِعُ may denote such rainwater excavations or waterworks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Towns or villages, especially with their cultivated land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective plural use reported for the plural form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Places set apart for horses away from tents or houses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural use; the singular is مَصْنَعَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fabricated or coined speech, a phrase or word innovated and presented as eloquent Arabic; forged wording or poetry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative passive-participle use, distinct from an actually manufactured object.

cautions: The Form VIII Quranic expression وَاصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي supports both special selection and exceptional rearing or preparation; the artifact preserves both readings as distinct but closely related senses.

مَصَانِعُ in 26:129 is a context-sensitive plural: the Quranic evidence supports substantial constructed places or strongholds, while broader Classical Arabic evidence also records reservoirs, wells, towns, and horse compounds.
The report that صَنِعَ means 'to become skilled' is attributed to one authority and rejected by another; it is retained as a qualified Classical meaning rather than treated as a Quranic sense.
